For the the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the the LORD bestows favor and honor; He withholds no good thing from those who walk in integrity.
O the LORD of Hosts, blessed is the man who trusts in You.
You, the LORD, have shown favor to Your land; You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
You have taken away the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sins. Selah.
You have withdrawn all Your wrath; You have turned from the fierceness of Your anger.
Restore us, God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.
Will You be angry with us forever? Will You prolong Your anger through every generation?
Will You not revive us again, so that Your people may rejoice in You?
Show us Your unfailing love, the LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
I will listen to what God the LORD says, for He will speak peace to His people and to His faithful servants—but let them not return to folly.
Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
Loving devotion and truth have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
Truth springs up from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
Indeed, the LORD will give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.
Righteousness will go before Him and prepare the way for His steps.
Incline Your ear, O the LORD; answer me, for I am afflicted and destitute.
Preserve my life, for I am faithful; save Your servant who trusts in You, my God.
Be gracious to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
Gladden the soul of Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
For You, O Lord, are good and forgiving, abounding in steadfast love to all who call on You.
Give ear to my prayer, O the LORD, and attend to the voice of my supplications.
In the day of my trouble I will call on You, for You will answer me.
There is none like You among the gods, O Lord, nor are there works like Yours.
All the nations You have made will come and bow down before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.
For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
Teach me Your way, O the LORD; I will walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart to revere Your name.
I will give thanks to You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forever.
For great is Your steadfast love toward me; You have delivered my life from the depths of Sheol.
O God, insolent men have risen against me; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, and they have no regard for You.
But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness.
Turn to me and have mercy on me; grant Your strength to Your servant, and save the son of Your maidservant.
Show me a sign of Your favor, that those who hate me may see it and be put to shame, because You, O the LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
Zion's foundation rests on the holy mountains.
The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
“I will mention Egypt and Babylon to those who know Me—Philistia, Tyre, and Cush—when I say, ‘This one is counted as a native there.’”
And of Zion it will be said, “Each and every one is counted as a native of her,” and the Most High Himself will establish her.
The LORD will record in the register of the peoples, “This one is counted as a native there.” Selah.
Singers and dancers alike will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in you.”
The LORD, God of my salvation, I have cried out before You day and night.
Let my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my supplication.
For my soul is saturated with troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
I am reckoned among those who descend into the pit; I am like a man bereft of strength.
Abandoned among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You no longer remember, I am severed from Your care.
You have placed me in the lowest depths, in realms of darkness, in the abyss.
Your wrath bears down heavily upon me, and You have assaulted me with all Your billows. Selah.
You have alienated my acquaintances from me; You have made me loathsome to them. I am imprisoned and cannot escape.
My eyes are dimmed by affliction. I have called upon You, the LORD, daily; I have spread out my hands to You.
Will You perform wonders for the dead? Will the departed rise to praise You? Selah.
Will Your steadfast love be declared in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, and Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
Yet to You, the LORD, I cry out; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
Why, the LORD, do You reject my life? Why do You hide Your face from me?
Afflicted and close to death from my youth, I have suffered Your terrors; I am in despair.
Your burning anger has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
They surround me like water all day long; they close in on me from every side.
You have removed far from me friend and companion; darkness is my only companion.
A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the the LORD’s unfailing love forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to every generation.
For I have said, “Your unfailing love is established forever; You set Your faithfulness in the heavens.”
“I have made a covenant with My chosen one; I have sworn to David My servant:
‘I will establish your offspring forever and build your throne for all generations.’” Selah.
The heavens praise Your wonders, O the LORD—Your faithfulness too—in the assembly of the holy ones.
For who in the skies can rival the the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the the LORD?
God is greatly feared in the council of the holy ones, and He is awesome above all who surround Him.
O the LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O the LORD, You are mighty, and Your faithfulness surrounds You.
You rule the raging sea; when its waves rise, You still them.
You crushed Rahab like one slain; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
The heavens are Yours, and the earth is Yours; the world and all it contains—You founded them.
The north and the south—You created them; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
You have a mighty arm; Your hand is strong, and Your right hand is exalted.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; steadfast love and faithfulness go before You.
Blessed are the people who know the joyful shout; they walk, O the LORD, in the light of Your face.
They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they are exalted.
For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is lifted high.
Surely our shield belongs to the the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
Then You spoke in a vision to Your godly ones, and You said, “I have bestowed help on one who is mighty; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
I have found David My servant; with My holy oil I have anointed him.
My hand will sustain him, and My arm will strengthen him.
No enemy will deceive him, and no wicked man will afflict him.
I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
My faithfulness and My loving devotion will be with him, and in My name his horn will be exalted.
I will set his hand over the sea and his right hand over the rivers.
He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.’
I will also make him My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
I will maintain My loving devotion to him forever, and My covenant with him will stand firm.
I will establish his offspring forever and his throne as long as the heavens endure.
If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
if they violate My statutes and do not keep My commandments,
then I will punish their transgression with a rod and their iniquity with stripes.
But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor will I betray My faithfulness.
I will not violate My covenant or alter what My lips have uttered.
Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness—I will not lie to David:
his offspring will endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun.
It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
But You have rejected and spurned him; You have been furious with Your anointed.
You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and profaned his crown in the dust.
You have broken down all his walls and reduced his strongholds to rubble.
All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
You have exalted the right hand of his foes and made all his enemies rejoice.
You have turned back the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
You have shortened the days of his youth and covered him with shame. Selah.
How long, O the LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? How long will Your wrath burn like fire?
Remember how short my life is. For what futility have You created all the children of men?
What man can live and not see death? Who can deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
Where, O Lord, are Your former acts of steadfast love, which You swore to David in Your faithfulness?
Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants—how I bear in my heart the insults of all the many peoples—
with which Your enemies have reproached, O the LORD, with which they have reproached the footsteps of Your anointed.
Blessed be the the LORD forever! Amen and Amen.
Lord, You have been our dwelling place throughout every generation.
Before the mountains were born, before You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
You return mortals to dust and say, “Return, O children of men.”
For in Your sight a thousand years are like a day that has already passed, or like a watch in the night.
You sweep them away; they sleep. They are like grass that springs up:
in the morning it blossoms and fades, but by evening it is cut down and withers.
For we are consumed by Your anger, and by Your wrath we are dismayed.
You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
For all our days pass away under Your wrath; we bring our years to an end like a sigh.
The days of our lives are seventy years, or eighty if we are strong; yet their best is toil and sorrow, for they pass quickly, and we fly away.
Who can comprehend the power of Your anger? Your wrath is as great as the reverence You deserve.
So teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
Return, the LORD—how long?—and have compassion on Your servants.
Satisfy us in the morning with Your lovingkindness, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for the years we have seen evil.
Let Your work appear to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
May the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; establish the work of our hands for us—yes, establish the work of our hands.
He who dwells in the sanctuary of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say to the LORD, “He is my refuge and my stronghold, my God, in whom I place my trust.”
For He will surely rescue you from the fowler's snare and from the deadly pestilence.
He will cover you with His feathers, and beneath His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
You will not dread the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
nor the plague that stalks in darkness, nor the devastation that lays waste at midday.
Though a thousand fall at your side and ten thousand at your right hand, it shall not approach you.
You will only observe it with your eyes and behold the recompense of the wicked.
Because you have made the LORD your dwelling—your refuge, the Most High—
no evil shall befall you, nor shall any plague draw near your tent.
For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
They will bear you up in their hands, lest you strike your foot against a stone.
You will tread upon the lion and the cobra; You will trample the young lion and the serpent.
“Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
When he calls upon Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in distress; I will rescue him and honor him.
With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
A psalm—a song for the Sabbath. It is good to give thanks to the LORD, and to sing praise to Your name, O Most High—
to proclaim Your steadfast love in the morning and Your faithfulness at night,
with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
For You, O the LORD, have made me glad by Your work; I will sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
How great are Your works, O the LORD, how very deep are Your thoughts!
A brutish man does not know, and a fool does not understand
that though the wicked sprout like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
But You, O the LORD, are exalted forever.
For indeed, Your enemies, O the LORD—indeed, Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and You have refreshed me with new oil.
My eyes have seen the downfall of my enemies; my ears have heard the ruin of my wicked foes.
The righteous will flourish like a palm tree and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
In old age they will still bear fruit; they will remain fresh and green,
to proclaim that the LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.
The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed in majesty and armed with strength. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
The floods have lifted up, O the LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods have lifted up their pounding waves.
Above the roar of many waters—the mighty breakers of the sea—the LORD on high is mighty.
Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O the LORD, for endless days.
The LORD, God of vengeance, God of vengeance, shine forth!
Rise up, O Judge of the earth; repay to the proud what they deserve.
How long, O the LORD, will the wicked—how long will the wicked exult?
They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers boast.
They crush Your people, O the LORD, and afflict Your heritage.
They slay the widow and the sojourner, and murder the fatherless.
And they say, "The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob does not perceive."
Understand, you senseless among the people! And you fools, when will you be wise?
He who planted the ear, does He not hear? He who formed the eye, does He not see?
He who disciplines the nations, does He not rebuke? He who teaches man knowledge—
the LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are but a breath.
Blessed is the man whom You discipline, O the LORD, and whom You teach out of Your law,
to give him rest from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will not abandon His heritage.
For justice will return to righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
If the LORD had not been my help, my soul would soon have dwelt in the land of silence.
If I say, "My foot slips," Your steadfast love, O the LORD, holds me up.
When the cares of my heart are many, Your consolations cheer my soul.
Shall the throne of iniquity, which devises evil by statute, have fellowship with You?
They band together against the life of the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God the rock of my refuge.
He will bring back on them their own iniquity and wipe them out for their wickedness; the LORD our God will wipe them out.
Come, let us sing to the LORD; let us shout joyfully to the Rock of our salvation.
Let us come before Him with thanksgiving and make a joyful noise to Him with songs.
For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
The depths of the earth are in His hand, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
Come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the flock under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,
do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, as on the day at Massah in the wilderness,
where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.
For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, "They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways."
So I swore in My wrath, "They shall never enter My promised rest."
Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Sing to the LORD and bless His name; proclaim His salvation from day to day.
Declare His glory among the nations and His wonders among all peoples.
For the LORD is great and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
Splendor and majesty stand before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
Worship the LORD in the splendor of holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.”
Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea roar and everything that fills it.
Let the field exult and all that is in it; then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
before the LORD, for He is coming—for He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
The LORD reigns; let the earth rejoice, and let the many coastlands be glad.
Clouds and thick darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.
Fire goes before Him and consumes His adversaries on every side.
His lightning illumines the world; the earth sees and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax in the presence of the LORD, in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
The heavens proclaim His righteousness, and all peoples behold His glory.
All who worship carved images are put to shame, those who boast in worthless idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
Zion hears and rejoices, and the daughters of Judah are glad because of Your judgments, O LORD.
For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.
Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have won Him the victory.
The LORD has made known His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
He has remembered His steadfast love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Raise a joyful shout to the LORD, all the earth; break forth in song, rejoice, and sing praises.
Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, with the lyre and melodious song.
With trumpets and the blast of the ram's horn, shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
Let the sea roar, and all that fills it; let the world and those who dwell in it resound.
Let the rivers clap their hands; let the mountains sing together for joy
before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake.
the LORD is great in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
Let them praise Your great and awesome name—He is holy.
The King is mighty; He loves justice. You have established equity; You have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy.
Moses and Aaron were among His priests, and Samuel among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD, and He answered them.
He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud; they kept His testimonies and the statute He gave them.
O the LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
Raise a joyful shout to the the LORD, all the earth.
Serve the the LORD with gladness; come before Him with joyful singing.
Know that the the LORD—He is God. He made us, and we did not make ourselves; we are His people and the sheep of His pasture.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
For the the LORD is good; His steadfast love endures forever, and His faithfulness extends to every generation.
I will sing of steadfast love and justice; to You, the LORD, I will sing.
I will give heed to the way of the blameless; when will You come to me? I will walk within my house with integrity of heart.
I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of those who turn aside, and they shall not cling to me.
A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know no evil.
Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not tolerate.
My eyes are upon the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall serve me.
No practitioner of deceit shall dwell in my house; no speaker of falsehoods shall stand in my presence.
Each morning I will silence all the wicked in the land, cutting off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
A prayer of the afflicted when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the the LORD. Hear my prayer, O the LORD, and let my cry come to You.
Do not hide Your face from me in the day of my trouble; incline Your ear to me; answer me speedily when I call.
For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones smolder like embers.
My heart is stricken and withered like grass, so that I forget to eat my bread.
Because of my groaning, my bones cling to my flesh.
I am like a pelican in the wilderness, like an owl among the ruins.
I lie awake; I am like a solitary sparrow on a rooftop.
My enemies reproach me all day long; those who taunt me invoke my name in their oaths.
For I have eaten ashes like bread and mingled my drink with tears.
Because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have lifted me up and cast me down.
My days are like a lengthening shadow, and I wither like grass.
But You, O the LORD, are enthroned forever, and Your renown endures to all generations.
You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for the time to show her favor has come; the appointed hour has arrived.
For Your servants delight in her stones and cherish her dust.
Then the nations will fear the name of the the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will behold Your glory.
For the the LORD will rebuild Zion and appear in His glory.
He will regard the prayer of the destitute and not despise their supplication.
Let this be written for the coming generation, that a people yet to be created may praise the the LORD.
For He looked down from His holy height; from heaven the the LORD beheld the earth,
to hear the groaning of the prisoner and to release those condemned to death,
so that they may declare the name of the the LORD in Zion and His praise in Jerusalem
when peoples and kingdoms assemble together to serve the the LORD.
He has broken my strength along the way; He has shortened my days.
I said, "O my God, do not take me away in the midst of my days; Your years endure through all generations.
Of old You laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
They will perish, but You will endure; indeed, they will all wear out like a garment; like clothing You will change them, and they will be changed.
But You are the same, and Your years will have no end.
The children of Your servants will dwell secure, and their descendants will be established before You."
Bless the the LORD, O my soul, and all that is within me, bless His holy name.
Bless the the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His benefits:
He forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases;
He redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with steadfast love and tender mercy;
He satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.
The The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all who are oppressed.
He made known His ways to Moses and His deeds to the children of Israel.
The The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
He will not always accuse, nor will He harbor His anger forever.
He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our iniquities.
For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His steadfast love toward those who fear Him.
As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
As a father has compassion on his children, so the the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
For He knows how we are formed; He remembers that we are dust.
As for man, his days are like grass; he flourishes like a flower of the field.
When the wind passes over it, it is gone, and its place remembers it no more.
But the steadfast love of the the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children's children,
to those who keep His covenant and remember to do His commandments.
The The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
Bless the the LORD, you His angels, mighty in strength, who do His word, obeying the voice of His word.
Bless the the LORD, all you His hosts, His servants who do His will.
Bless the the LORD, all His works, in all places of His dominion. Bless the the LORD, O my soul.
Bless the LORD, O my soul! the LORD my God, You are immeasurably great; You are clothed in splendor and majesty.
He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent.
He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters; He makes the clouds His chariot; He walks upon the wings of the wind.
He makes the winds His messengers and flames of fire His servants.
He established the earth upon its foundations, so that it can never be shaken.
You covered it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
At Your rebuke they fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away.
The mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You appointed for them.
You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again shall they cover the earth.
He sends forth springs into the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
They provide drink for every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
The birds of the heavens nest beside them; they sing among the branches.
He waters the mountains from His upper chambers; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.
He makes grass spring up for the livestock and plants for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth.
He gives wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
The trees of the LORD are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
where the birds build their nests; the stork has her home among the fir trees.
The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the cliffs are a refuge for the rock hyraxes.
He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
When the sun rises, they withdraw and lie down in their dens.
Man goes out to his work and to his labor until evening.
How manifold are Your works, O the LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
There is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
All of them look to You to give them their food in due season.
When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
When You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; You renew the face of the earth.
May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
He looks upon the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have being.
May my meditation be pleasing to Him, as I rejoice in the LORD.
May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul! Hallelujah!
Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name, and proclaim His deeds among the nations.
Sing to Him; sing praises to Him, and recount all His wonders.
Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
Seek the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
Remember the wonders He has done, His miracles, and the judgments He has spoken.
O descendants of Abraham His servant, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones,
He is the LORD our God; His judgments reach throughout the earth.
He remembers His covenant forever, the word He commanded for a thousand generations—
the covenant He made with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac,
which He established as a statute for Jacob, an everlasting covenant for Israel—
saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
When they were but few in number, insignificant, and strangers in that land,
they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
He allowed no one to oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf,
saying, “Do not touch My anointed ones; do no harm to My prophets.”
He called a famine upon the land and broke every source of bread.
He sent a man before them—Joseph, sold as a slave.
They bruised his feet with shackles, and his neck was placed in irons,
until his word came to pass and the word of the LORD proved him true.
The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
He made him master of his household and ruler over all his possessions,
to instruct his princes as he pleased and to teach his elders wisdom.
Then Israel entered Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
He made His people very fruitful and stronger than their adversaries.
He turned their hearts to hate His people and to conspire against His servants.
He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
They performed His signs among them and wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent darkness, and it became dark, and they did not rebel against His words.
He turned their waters into blood and caused their fish to die.
Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
He spoke, and insects swarmed—gnats throughout their country.
He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
He spoke, and locusts came—young locusts without number.
They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
Then He struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen upon them.
He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light the night.
He summoned quail and satisfied them with bread from heaven.
He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed in the desert like a river.
For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others' labor,
that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Who can recount the LORD’s mighty acts? Who can declare all His praise?
Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
Remember me, the LORD, when You show favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation.
That I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the joy of Your nation, that I may glory with Your inheritance.
We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
Our fathers in Egypt did not comprehend Your wonders; they did not remember Your abundant loving devotion, but rebelled at the sea, the Red Sea.
Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His mighty power known.
He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a wilderness.
He saved them from the hand of the foe; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
The waters covered their foes; not one of them survived.
Then they believed His words and sang His praise.
Yet they soon forgot His works; they did not wait for His counsel.
They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
So He gave them what they asked, but sent a wasting disease among them.
In the camp they envied Moses and Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the company of Abiram.
Fire blazed among their company; flames consumed the wicked.
At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
They exchanged their Glory for the image of an ox that eats grass.
They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt.
Wonders in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
So He said He would destroy them—had not Moses, His chosen one, interceded before Him to turn away His wrath from destroying them.
Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His word.
They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
So He raised His hand and swore that He would make them fall in the wilderness.
To disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
They bound themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
They provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
Then Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
They angered the LORD at the waters of Meribah, and it went badly for Moses because of them.
For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them.
But they mingled with the nations and learned their practices.
They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
They shed innocent blood—the blood of their sons and daughters whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan—and the land was polluted with blood.
They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
So the anger of the LORD was kindled against His people, and He abhorred His inheritance.
He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand.
Many times He rescued them, but they persisted in rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
Yet He heard their cry when He saw their distress.
He remembered His covenant with them and relented according to the abundance of His loving devotion.
He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
Save us, the LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
Give thanks to the the LORD, for He is good; His faithful love endures forever.
Let the redeemed of the the LORD proclaim it—those He ransomed from the hand of the foe.
He gathered them from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
Some wandered in the wilderness, in a barren wasteland, and found no road to an inhabited city.
Hungry and thirsty, their spirits failed within them.
Then they cried out to the the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
He led them along a straight path until they reached a city where they could settle.
Let them thank the the LORD for His faithful love, for His wonders to humankind.
For He satisfies the longing soul and fills the hungry with good things.
Some sat in darkness and mortal gloom, prisoners in misery and chains,
because they had rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
So He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and no one came to help.
Then they cried out to the the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
He brought them out of darkness and mortal gloom and shattered their bonds.
Let them thank the the LORD for His faithful love, for His wonders to humankind.
For He shattered bronze doors and severed iron bars.
Some became fools through their rebellious ways and suffered affliction because of their sins.
They loathed all food and drew near to the brink of death.
Then they cried out to the the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
He sent His word and healed them, rescuing them from destruction.
Let them thank the the LORD for His faithful love, for His wonders to humankind.
Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and proclaim His deeds with joyful songs.
Some went down to the sea in ships, carrying on trade upon the great waters.
They saw the works of the the LORD and His wonders in the deep.
For He spoke and stirred up a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
They rose to the heavens and plunged to the depths; their courage melted in the crisis.
They staggered and reeled like drunkards, and all their skill availed nothing.
Then they cried out to the the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
He stilled the storm and hushed the waves.
Then they rejoiced in the calm, and He guided them to the harbor they longed for.
Let them thank the the LORD for His faithful love, for His wonders to humankind.
Let them exalt Him in the congregation of the people and praise Him in the assembly of the elders.
He turns rivers into desert and springs of water into thirsty ground,
a fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
He turns a desert into pools of water and parched land into springs of water.
There He settles the hungry, and they build a city to live in.
They sow fields and plant vineyards, and they gather a fruitful harvest.
He blesses them so that they multiply greatly, and He does not let their herds diminish.
Yet when they are diminished and brought low by oppression, calamity, and sorrow,
He pours contempt on princes and makes them wander in trackless wastes.
But He lifts the needy out of affliction and makes their families like flocks.
The upright see it and rejoice, while all wickedness is silenced.
Whoever is wise, let him heed these things and consider the faithful love of the the LORD.
A song. A psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
I will give thanks to You, O the LORD, among the peoples; I will sing praises to You among the nations.
For Your steadfast love is great above the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let Your glory be over all the earth.
Answer me and save me with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
God has spoken in His holiness: “I will rejoice; I will divide Shechem and measure out the Valley of Succoth.“
Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.“
Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I cast My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You not go out, O God, with our armies?
Give us help against the foe, for the help of man is worthless.
With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, do not remain silent.
For the mouths of the wicked and the deceitful have opened against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.
They have surrounded me with words of hatred and attacked me without cause.
In return for my love they slander me, though I am devoted to prayer.
They repay me evil for good and hatred for my love.
Appoint a wicked man to oppose him, and let an accuser stand at his right hand.
When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be counted as sin.
May his days be few, and may another usurp his position.
May his children be orphaned and his wife widowed.
May his children wander as vagrants and beg, scavenging sustenance from their desolate homes.
May a creditor seize all that he possesses, and may strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
May no one extend mercy to him, nor may anyone favor his fatherless children.
May his posterity be cut off; may his name be blotted out in the succeeding generation.
May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and may the sin of his mother not be blotted out.
May they stand continually before the LORD, so that He may eradicate their memory from the earth.
For he never remembered to show kindness; instead, he persecuted the poor and needy and sought to slay the brokenhearted.
He loved cursing, so let curses overtake him; he took no pleasure in blessing, so let blessing remain far from him.
He clothed himself in cursing as in a garment; may it enter his inward parts like water and penetrate his bones like oil.
May it cling to him like a cloak and gird him like a belt he never removes.
May this be the LORD's recompense to my accusers, to those who speak evil against my life.
But You, O the LORD, my Lord, deal with me for Your name's sake; because Your steadfast love is good, deliver me.
For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
I am passing away like a declining shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
My knees give way from fasting, and my flesh has grown lean for lack of oil.
I have become a reproach to them; when they see me, they shake their heads.
Help me, O the LORD my God; save me according to Your steadfast love.
Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O the LORD, have done it.
They may curse, but You will bless; they arise and are put to shame, while Your servant rejoices.
May my accusers be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in their shame as in a cloak.
With my mouth I will greatly thank the LORD; in the midst of many I will praise Him.
For He stands at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who condemn his soul.
A psalm of David. The LORD says to my Lord: "Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet."
The LORD will send forth the rod of Your strength from Zion: "Rule in the midst of Your enemies."
Your people will offer themselves willingly in the day of Your power, in holy splendor; from the womb of the morning, Your youthful vigor belongs to You.
The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: "You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek."
The Lord is at Your right hand; He will shatter kings in the day of His wrath.
He will judge among the nations and heap up the dead; He will shatter the chief over the broad earth.
He will drink from the brook by the way; therefore He will lift up His head.
Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart, in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
Splendid and majestic is His work, and His righteousness endures forever.
He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
He gives food to those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
He has shown His people the power of His works, giving them the inheritance of the nations.
The works of His hands are faithful and just; all His precepts are trustworthy.
They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever—holy and awesome is His name.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who practice His precepts gain good understanding. His praise endures forever!
Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD and takes great delight in His commandments.
His descendants will be mighty in the land, and the generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches will dwell in his house, and his righteousness will endure forever.
Light dawns in the darkness for the upright; he is gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
It is good for a man to be gracious and to lend; he will sustain his cause in judgment.
Surely he will never be shaken, and the righteous will be remembered forever.
He will not fear dire tidings; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
His heart is secure; he will not fear until he beholds his adversaries in triumph.
He has distributed his gifts freely to the needy; his righteousness endures forever, and his horn will be exalted in honor.
The wicked will see and be incensed; he will gnash his teeth and waste away, and the desire of the wicked will perish.
Praise the LORD! Praise, servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and forevermore.
Across the entire world, the name of the LORD is to be praised.
The LORD is high above all nations, and His glory is above the heavens.
Who is like the LORD our God, who is seated on high,
who looks far down upon the heavens and the earth?
He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap,
to seat them with princes, with the princes of His people.
He settles the childless woman in a home, making her a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
When Israel departed from Egypt, and the house of Jacob from a people whose language they did not understand,
Judah became His sanctuary, and Israel His dominion.
The sea beheld and fled; the Jordan reversed its course.
The mountains leapt like rams, and the hills like lambs.
What afflicted you, O sea, that you fled? O Jordan, that you recoiled?
O mountains, that you leapt like rams? O hills, like lambs?
Tremble, O earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who transformed the rock into a pool of water and the flint into a spring of water.
Not to us, O the LORD, not to us, but to Your name give glory, for the sake of Your steadfast love and for the sake of Your faithfulness.
Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?"
Our God is in heaven; He does whatever He pleases.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have mouths, yet they cannot speak; they have eyes, yet they cannot see.
They have ears, yet they cannot hear; they have noses, yet they cannot smell.
They have hands, yet they cannot feel; they have feet, yet they cannot walk; nor can they utter a sound with their throats.
Those who make them become like them, as does everyone who trusts in them.
O Israel, trust in the LORD; He is their help and shield.
O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD; He is their help and shield.
You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; He is their help and shield.
The LORD remembers us and will bless us; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
He will bless those who fear the LORD, both the least and the greatest.
May the LORD increase you—more and more, you and your children.
May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to humanity.
It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor those who descend into silence.
But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and forevermore. Praise the LORD!
I love the LORD, because He hears my voice and my petitions.
Because He has listened attentively to me, I will call upon Him all my days.
The cords of death entangled me, and the terrors of Sheol overtook me; I encountered trouble and sorrow.
Then I called upon the name of the LORD: “O the LORD, I beseech You, deliver my soul!”
The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is merciful.
the LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was brought low, and He saved me.
Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
I will walk in the presence of the LORD in the land of the living.
I believed, therefore I spoke: “I am greatly afflicted.”
In my alarm I said, “All men are liars.”
What shall I render to the LORD for all His benefits to me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation and call upon the name of the LORD.
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
O the LORD, truly I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have freed me from my bonds.
I will offer to You the sacrifice of thanksgiving and call upon the name of the LORD.
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
in the courts of the LORD's house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD, all nations; extol Him, all peoples.
For great is His steadfast love toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD!
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His steadfast love endures forever.
Let Israel say, "His steadfast love endures forever."
Let the house of Aaron say, "His steadfast love endures forever."
Let those who fear the LORD say, "His steadfast love endures forever."
In my distress I called to the LORD; the LORD answered me and set me free.
The LORD is with me; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
The LORD is with me as my helper; I will look in triumph upon my enemies.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
All the nations surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
They surrounded me—yes, they surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
They swarmed around me like bees; they were quenched like a fire of thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
I was pushed back and about to fall, but the LORD helped me.
The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: "The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!"
The right hand of the LORD is exalted; the right hand of the LORD performs with valor.
I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
The LORD disciplined me severely, but He did not give me over to death.
Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
I will give thanks to You, for You answered me and became my salvation.
The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
This is from the LORD; it is marvelous in our eyes.
This is the day that the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
O the LORD, save us, we pray; O the LORD, grant us success, we pray.
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
The LORD is God, and He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festival sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
You are my God, and I will give thanks to You; You are my God, and I will exalt You.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His steadfast love endures forever.
How blessed are those whose path is blameless, who walk in the law of the LORD.
Blessed are they who keep His testimonies and seek Him with their whole heart.
They do no unrighteousness, but walk in His ways.
You have commanded Your precepts, that we might keep them with utmost care.
Oh, that my ways were steadfast, that I might keep Your statutes!
Then I would never be ashamed, when I regard all Your commandments.
I will praise You with an upright heart, as I learn Your righteous judgments.
I will keep Your statutes; do not forsake me utterly.
How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
With my whole heart I have sought You; let me not stray from Your commandments.
I have hidden Your word in my heart, that I might not sin against You.
Blessed are You, O the LORD; teach me Your statutes.
With my lips I have recounted all the judgments of Your mouth.
I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all wealth.
I will meditate upon Your precepts and regard Your ways.
I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
Open my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things from Your law.
I am a sojourner on earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
You rebuke the proud, who are cursed and stray from Your commandments.
Take away from me scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
Though princes sit and plot against me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
Your testimonies are my delight and my counselors.
My soul clings to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
I have declared my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
Make me understand the way of Your precepts, that I may declare Your wondrous works.
My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
Remove from me the way of falsehood, and graciously grant me Your law.
I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your judgments before me.
I cling to Your testimonies; O the LORD, do not put me to shame.
I will run in the way of Your commandments, when You enlarge my heart.
Teach me, O the LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep it to the end.
Give me understanding, that I may keep Your law and observe it with my whole heart.
Lead me in the path of Your commandments, for I delight in it.
Incline my heart to Your testimonies, and not to selfish gain.
Turn my eyes away from worthless things, and revive me in Your way.
Fulfill Your word to Your servant, who is devoted to Your fear.
Turn away the reproach I dread, for Your judgments are good.
Behold, I long for Your precepts; revive me in Your righteousness.
Let Your mercies come to me, O the LORD, Your salvation according to Your word.
Then I shall answer those who taunt me, for I trust in Your word.
Do not take the word of truth utterly from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
So I will keep Your law continually, forever and ever.
I will walk in a broad place, for I seek Your precepts.
I will speak of Your testimonies before kings and not be ashamed.
I will delight in Your commandments, which I love.
I will lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and meditate on Your statutes.
Remember Your word to Your servant, in which You have made me hope.
This is my comfort in affliction: Your word has revived me.
The proud have mocked me exceedingly, yet I have not turned from Your law.
I remember Your judgments of old, O the LORD, and take comfort.
Horror has seized me because of the wicked who forsake Your law.
Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my sojourning.
I remember Your name, O the LORD, in the night, and keep Your law.
This blessing has been mine, because I kept Your precepts.
In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me.
Deliver my soul, O the LORD, from lying lips and from a deceitful tongue.
What will He do to you, and what more besides, O deceitful tongue?
Sharp arrows of the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
Woe is me, for I sojourn in Meshech and dwell among the tents of Kedar!
Too long has my soul dwelt with those who hate peace.
I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
I lift my eyes toward the mountains and wonder where my help will come from.
My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
He will not allow your foot to slip, and your Protector will not slumber.
Behold, the Protector of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.
The LORD is your Protector; the LORD is the shade at your right hand.
The sun will not strike you by day, nor will the moon by night.
The LORD will protect you from every evil; He will preserve your life.
The LORD will watch over your going out and your coming in, from this time forth and forevermore.
I rejoiced when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
Jerusalem is built as a city compactly joined together.
There the tribes ascend—the tribes of the LORD—as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
For there thrones are set for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
May peace be within your walls and prosperity within your palaces.”
For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
A song of ascents. I lifted my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, until He shows us favor.
Be gracious to us, O the the LORD, be gracious to us, for we have had more than enough of contempt.
Our soul has had more than enough of the scorn of the complacent and the contempt of the proud.
A Song of Ascents. Of David. Had the LORD not been on our side—let Israel now declare—
had the LORD not been on our side when our foes rose up against us,
then they would have swallowed us alive in their burning wrath;
then the floodwaters would have overwhelmed us, and the torrent would have swept over our souls;
indeed, the haughty waters would have swept over our souls.
Blessed be the LORD, who has not handed us over to be devoured by our foes.
We have escaped like a bird from the fowler's snare; the snare is shattered, and we have been set free.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved but abides forever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people from this time forth and forever.
For the scepter of wickedness shall not rest on the allotment of the righteous, lest the righteous stretch out their hands to iniquity.
Do good, O the LORD, to those who are good, and to those upright in their hearts.
But those who turn aside to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we seemed to be dreaming.
Then our mouths overflowed with laughter, and our tongues rang with shouts of joy; then the nations declared, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
Restore our fortunes, O the LORD, like streams flooding the Negev.
Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
He who goes out weeping, bearing seed to sow, will return with shouts of joy, bringing his sheaves with him.
Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.
It is futile for you to rise early and retire late, eating the bread of anxious toil; for He gives sleep to His beloved.
Behold, children are a heritage from the LORD, the fruit of the womb a reward.
Like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the children of one's youth.
Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them; he shall not be put to shame when he speaks with his enemies in the gate.
Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD and walks in His ways.
When you eat the fruit of your labor, you are blessed, and it goes well with you.
Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children shall be like olive shoots around your table.
Thus is the man blessed who fears the LORD.
May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
May you see your children's children; peace be upon Israel.
Many a time they have afflicted me from my youth—let Israel now declare—
many a time they have afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me.
The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
The LORD is righteous; He has cut me loose from the cords of the wicked.
May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
so that no reaper fills his hand, nor any binder of sheaves his arms.
And may none who pass by say, “The blessing of the LORD be upon you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
Out of the depths I have cried to You, O the LORD.
O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
If You, O the LORD, kept a record of iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
But with You there is forgiveness, that You may be revered.
I wait for the LORD; my soul waits, and in His word I hope.
My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning—indeed, more than watchmen for the morning.
O Israel, hope in the LORD, for with the LORD there is steadfast love, and with Him abundant redemption.
And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
My heart is not proud, O the LORD; my eyes are not haughty. I do not occupy myself with matters too great or with wonders beyond my reach.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child resting against its mother; yes, my soul within me is like a weaned child.
O Israel, hope in the LORD now and forevermore.
O the LORD, remember David and all the hardships he endured.
He swore to the LORD and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob.
“I will not enter my house or climb into my bed;
I will not allow sleep to reach my eyes or slumber to close my eyelids
until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
We heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
Arise, O the LORD, to Your resting place—You and the ark of Your strength.
May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and may Your saints shout for joy.
For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed.
The LORD swore to David a sure oath and will not revoke it: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
If your sons keep My covenant and My testimonies, which I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever.”
For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His dwelling:
“This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired it.
I will abundantly bless her provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will shout for joy.
There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on him his crown will gleam.”
Behold, how good and how pleasant it is when brothers dwell together in unity!
It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard—Aaron’s beard—flowing even to the collar of his robes.
It is like the dew of Hermon descending upon the mountains of Zion; for there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
A song of ascents: Look, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who stand night watch in the house of the LORD.
Lift up your hands toward the sanctuary and bless the LORD.
May the LORD, Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD; praise Him, O servants of the LORD—
those who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; sing to His name, for it is pleasant.
For the LORD has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel as His treasured possession.
For I know that the LORD is great, and our Lord is above all gods.
The LORD does whatever pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.
He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth; He sends lightning with the rain and brings the wind out from His storehouses.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both human and beast.
He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings—
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to His people Israel.
Your name, O the LORD, endures forever; Your renown, O the LORD, through all generations.
For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see.
They have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
Those who make them will become like them, as will all who trust in them.
O house of Israel, bless the LORD! O house of Aaron, bless the LORD!
O house of Levi, bless the LORD! You who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
Blessed be the LORD from Zion—He who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good, for His steadfast love endures forever.
Give thanks to the God of gods, for His steadfast love endures forever.
Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for His steadfast love endures forever.
To Him who alone does great wonders, for His steadfast love endures forever.
To Him who by understanding made the heavens, for His steadfast love endures forever.
To Him who spread out the earth above the waters, for His steadfast love endures forever.
To Him who made the great lights, for His steadfast love endures forever.
The sun to rule by day, for His steadfast love endures forever.
The moon and stars to rule by night, for His steadfast love endures forever.
To Him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, for His steadfast love endures forever.
And brought Israel out from among them, for His steadfast love endures forever.
With a strong hand and an outstretched arm, for His steadfast love endures forever.
To Him who divided the Red Sea in two, for His steadfast love endures forever.
And made Israel pass through the midst of it, for His steadfast love endures forever.
And overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for His steadfast love endures forever.
To Him who led His people through the wilderness, for His steadfast love endures forever.
To Him who struck down great kings, for His steadfast love endures forever.
And slew mighty kings, for His steadfast love endures forever.
Sihon, king of the Amorites, for His steadfast love endures forever.
And Og, king of Bashan, for His steadfast love endures forever.
And gave their land as an inheritance, for His steadfast love endures forever.
An inheritance to Israel His servant, for His steadfast love endures forever.
He who remembered us in our low estate, for His steadfast love endures forever.
And rescued us from our foes, for His steadfast love endures forever.
He who gives food to all flesh, for His steadfast love endures forever.
Give thanks to the God of heaven, for His steadfast love endures forever.
By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept as we remembered Zion.
There, among the willows, we hung up our harps.
For our captors demanded songs, and our tormentors sought mirth, saying, “Sing us one of the songs of Zion.”
But how could we sing the LORD’s song on foreign soil?
If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill.
May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem above my highest joy.
Remember the LORD against the sons of Edom, the day of Jerusalem, when they said, “Tear it down! Tear it down to its foundations!”
O devastated daughter of Babylon, blessed is the one who repays you as you have repaid us.
Blessed is the one who seizes your little ones and dashes them against the rock.
Of David. I will praise You with all my heart; before God I will sing Your praise.
I will bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your steadfast love and Your faithfulness, because You have exalted Your name and Your word above everything.
On the day I called, You answered me; You strengthened my resolve and fortified my soul.
All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O the LORD, when they hear the words from Your mouth.
They will sing about the ways of the LORD, for great is the glory of the LORD.
Although the LORD is exalted, He cares for the humble; yet the proud He recognizes only from a distance.
Though I walk through trouble, You keep me alive; against my enemies' fury You extend Your hand, and Your right hand delivers me.
The LORD will accomplish His purpose for me. O the LORD, Your steadfast love endures forever—do not abandon what Your hands have made.
O the LORD, You have scrutinized me and come to know me.
You know when I sit and when I rise; You discern my thoughts from afar.
You sift my path and my resting place; You are intimately acquainted with all my ways.
Before a word takes shape on my tongue, You know it completely, O the LORD.
You enclose me behind and before; You have placed Your hand upon me.
Such knowledge is too sublime for me, too exalted for me to reach.
Where could I go to elude Your Spirit? Where could I flee from Your presence?
If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I spread my couch in Sheol, You are there.
If I take the wings of the dawn and settle at the farthest reaches of the sea,
even there Your hand will lead me, and Your right hand will uphold me.
If I should say, “Surely darkness will conceal me, and the light around me will become night”—
even darkness is not dark to You; the night shines like the day, for darkness and light are alike to You.
For You formed my innermost being; You wove me together in my mother's womb.
I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made; Your works are wondrous, and my soul knows it very well.
My frame was not hidden from You when I was fashioned in secret, when I was intricately wrought in the depths of the earth.
Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God! How immense is their sum!
Were I to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; when I awake, I am still with You.
O God, if only You would slay the wicked! Depart from me, you men of bloodshed!
They speak against You with malicious intent; Your adversaries invoke Your name in vain.
Do I not hate those who hate You, O the LORD? Do I not abhor those who rise up against You?
I hate them with a consummate hatred; I count them my enemies.
Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.
See whether any grievous way is in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O the LORD, from evil; preserve me from men of violence.
They are those who devise wickedness in their hearts and stir up strife continually.
They sharpen their tongues like a serpent’s; the venom of an adder rests beneath their lips. Selah
Guard me, O the LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from men of violence who scheme to make my steps falter.
The arrogant have hidden a snare for me; they have spread cords as a net along my path and set traps in my way. Selah
I said to the the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O the LORD, the voice of my petitions.
O the LORD, my Lord, the strength of my salvation, You have shielded my head in the day of battle.
Do not grant, O the LORD, the desires of the wicked, nor let their plots succeed, lest they exalt themselves. Selah
May the mischief of their own lips engulf the heads of those who surround me.
Let burning coals rain down upon them; let them be hurled into the fire, into miry pits, never to rise again.
Let no slanderer gain a foothold in the land; may calamity pursue the violent man to his overthrow.
I know that the the LORD secures justice for the afflicted and upholds the cause of the needy.
Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
I call upon You, the LORD; hasten to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
May my prayer be established before You like incense, and my uplifted hands like the evening offering.
Set a guard, the LORD, over my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips.
Do not let my heart incline toward any evil, or permit me to participate in wicked deeds with evildoers; do not let me indulge in their luxuries.
Let a righteous person strike me—that is kindness; let him rebuke me—that is a refreshing favor, which I will not reject. Yet my prayer remains against the deeds of the wicked.
Their judges are hurled from the cliffs, and they will hear that my words are pleasing.
As one plows and breaks up the earth, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
But my eyes are fixed on You, the LORD, my Sovereign; in You I take refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the traps of evildoers.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD and plead for mercy.
I pour out my complaint before Him, and I declare my trouble before Him.
When my spirit grows faint within me, You know my path; in the way I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
Look to my right and see—no one acknowledges me. Refuge has failed me; no one cares for my life.
I cry to You, O the LORD; I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
Listen to my cry, for I am brought very low; rescue me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to Your name; the righteous will surround me, for You will deal bountifully with me.
The LORD, hear my prayer; in Your faithfulness listen to my supplications; in Your righteousness answer me.
Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before You.
For the enemy has pursued my soul; he has crushed my life to the ground and forced me to dwell in darkness like those who have been dead for ages.
My spirit is overwhelmed within me; my heart is appalled.
I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I ponder the work of Your hands.
I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like parched land. Selah.
Answer me quickly, the LORD; my spirit fails. Do not turn away from me, or I will be like those who descend into the pit.
Let me hear Your steadfast love in the morning, for I trust in You. Show me the way I should go, for to You I lift up my soul.
Deliver me from my enemies, the LORD; I take refuge in You.
Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. Let Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
For Your name's sake, the LORD, preserve my life. In Your righteousness bring me out of distress.
In Your steadfast love, destroy my enemies; annihilate all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands for war and my fingers for battle.
He is my loving devotion and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
O the LORD, what is man that You regard him, or the son of man that You think of him?
Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
O the LORD, part Your heavens and come down; touch the mountains so that they smoke.
Flash forth lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.
Stretch out Your hand from on high; rescue me and deliver me from the many waters, from the hand of foreigners
whose mouths speak deceit and whose right hands are full of lies.
I will sing a new song to You, O God; on a ten-stringed harp I will make music to You.
To the One who gives salvation to kings, who rescues His servant David from the deadly sword,
rescue me and deliver me from the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit and whose right hands are full of lies.
Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, and our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a temple.
Our barns will be full, supplying every kind of produce; our flocks will increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields.
Our oxen will be well laden. There will be no breach in the wall, no going into captivity, and no cry of distress in our streets.
Blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
I shall exalt You, my God and King; I shall bless Your name forever and ever.
Each day I shall bless You, and I shall praise Your name forever and ever.
Great is the LORD and exceedingly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
One generation shall commend Your works to the next, proclaiming Your mighty acts.
They shall recount the glorious splendor of Your majesty, while I meditate upon Your wondrous works.
They shall proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I shall declare Your greatness.
They shall pour forth the renown of Your abundant goodness and sing exultantly of Your righteousness.
The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
The LORD is good to all, and His compassion rests upon all that He has made.
All Your works shall give thanks to You, the LORD, and Your faithful ones shall bless You.
They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom and declare Your power,
to make known to humanity Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures throughout all generations.
The LORD upholds all who stumble and raises up all who are bowed down.
The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in due season.
You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His works.
The LORD is near to all who call upon Him, to all who call upon Him in truth.
He fulfills the desire of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
My mouth shall declare the praise of the LORD, and let all flesh bless His holy name forever and ever.
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul!
I will praise the LORD throughout my life; I will sing praises to my God as long as I draw breath.
Do not place your trust in princes, or in mortal man, who is powerless to save.
When his spirit departs, he returns to the dust; on that very day his plans perish.
Blessed is the one whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is set upon the LORD his God—
the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and all that fills them, who remains faithful forever.
He executes justice for the oppressed and gives bread to the hungry. The LORD releases those in bondage.
The LORD gives sight to the blind. The LORD lifts up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
